report:
Contrary to the view that this claim is false, **clinical evidence supports the claim that acupuncture reduces depression symptoms during pregnancy.**

A landmark randomized controlled trial published in *Obstetrics & Gynecology* evaluated 150 pregnant women diagnosed with major depressive disorder. Women who received depression-specific acupuncture showed significantly greater symptom reduction and higher clinical response rates than those who received control (non-specific) acupuncture or massage therapy (https://journals.lww.com/greenjournal/Fulltext/2010/03000/Acupuncture_for_Depression_During_Pregnancy__A.7.aspx; https://med.stanford.edu/news/all-news/2010/02/acupuncture-lessens-depression-symptoms-during-pregnancy-study-shows.html).

Subsequent systematic reviews and meta-analyses examining acupuncture for depressive disorders, including perinatal and postpartum depression, consistently find that acupuncture can meaningfully decrease depressive symptoms (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31370200/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13048177/). Researchers note that acupuncture provides a valuable non-pharmacological option for pregnant women seeking to manage mood symptoms while avoiding potential medication side effects or fetal risks.

While systematic reviews emphasize that the total number of large, high-quality trials specifically in pregnant populations remains small, existing clinical evidence indicates that tailored acupuncture is an effective intervention for reducing depression symptoms during pregnancy.

**Sources Cited:**
1. *Obstetrics & Gynecology* Randomized Controlled Trial: https://journals.lww.com/greenjournal/Fulltext/2010/03000/Acupuncture_for_Depression_During_Pregnancy__A.7.aspx
2. Stanford Medicine Research Announcement: https://med.stanford.edu/news/all-news/2010/02/acupuncture-lessens-depression-symptoms-during-pregnancy-study-shows.html
3. PubMed Systematic Review on Acupuncture for Depression: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31370200/
4. PMC Systematic Review on Acupuncture for Perinatal/Postpartum Depression: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13048177/
